# pqblocks-cbom

CycloneDX 1.5 CBOM metadata enrichment engine injecting quantum-safe classifications and CNSA 2.0 compliance properties.

High-throughput CycloneDX 1.5 CBOM metadata enrichment engine injecting quantum-safe classifications and CNSA 2.0 compliance properties.

- **Area:** Migration & readiness
- **Install:** `pip install git+https://github.com/PQBlocks/cbom-enricher`
- **Import:** `import pqblocks_cbom`
- **Command line:** `pqblocks-cbom`
- **Native dependency:** liboqs (Open Quantum Safe)
- **Status:** 0.1.0 Alpha, Python >=3.11
- **Docs:** https://pqblocks.github.io/packages/cbom/ · repository https://github.com/PQBlocks/cbom-enricher

## Quickstart (executed against the package)

```python
from pqblocks_cbom import CBOMEnricher, CBOMProfile

# Initialize enricher with NSA CNSA 2.0 profile
enricher = CBOMEnricher(CBOMProfile.CNSA20)

sbom = {
    "bomFormat": "CycloneDX",
    "specVersion": "1.5",
    "version": 1,
    "components": [
        {"type": "library", "name": "liboqs", "version": "3.5.7"}
    ]
}

cbom = enricher.enrich_sbom(sbom)
print("Enriched components:", len(cbom["components"]))
print("Injected properties:", [p["name"] for p in cbom["components"][0]["properties"]])
```
